protocol: One fresh independent collaboration context per case and condition; implementation and self-tests followed by independent clean replay and undisclosed external consumer tests. No patch repairs by the grader.
model: Inherited host model; exact backend identifier, sampling parameters, token counts and inference costs are not exposed. No model override.
tools: Local source reads/edits and offline Cargo; no browsing, external writes, other packets, or delegation by evaluated agents. Isolation is procedural, not a security sandbox between agents.
scope: Complete unmodified rhwp-contracts crate in a minimal workspace. All 12 locked package versions/checksums match the upstream lock. Full rhwp root engine, CLI, bindings, WASM and UI are excluded.
selection: Three maintainer-designed feature/robustness tasks on real source. Not upstream issue reproductions or a blinded held-out sample. Candidate runtime unchanged from v0.1.0.
grading: Frozen compiler/test/lint/format/scope gates plus primary-agent non-blinded source review; no semantic LLM grader.
limitations: One run per cell, no repetition or statistical significance.
Run order is predeclared and rotated, not randomized.
Three tasks in one small crate do not measure engine-scale refactoring or every Rust pattern.
Existing Korean source and contract strings are preserved. New evaluation prose is English.
Source excerpts in patches retain rhwp MIT attribution in LICENSES/rhwp-MIT.txt.

method_amendments.stage: Before any completed agent output was inspected or assessed; first three implementation sessions were in progress.
method_amendments.change: Corrected diff provenance for forbidden root workspace/lockfile edits and handled a deleted source file as a scope failure.

publication_normalization: Host-specific evaluation-repository paths and canonical temporary-workspace prefixes in result JSON/logs are normalized. Input/output manifests, patches, diagnostics and substantive response text are unchanged. Pre-normalization captures are retained in the local ignored cache.
